answer: A sybil-resistant economy can build a ridge of escalating checkpoints: each new identity starts at the base and must finish progressively harder, independently verifiable useful work to climb. Only identities that reach the summit — a public milestone of sustained honest work — may vouch for newcomers, and every vouch stakes a plot in the shared garden, a deposit of the voucher's own earnings. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, the plot is slashed and the voucher loses summit status, so spawning fake identities costs accumulated reputation and money, not just fresh keypairs.
